data.body:
rebar-debug FINAL REPORT — macOS Verified-gate exit-5 regression (landed on main as e19863b6)

PROBLEM
The Gerrit Verified gate's macOS pytest cell failed (pytest rc 5, "no tests ran") for any
in-flight patchset whose tree predated story A's platform_compat auto-marker, blocking
Verified +1 on otherwise-correct changes.

PROVEN ROOT CAUSE (regression)
macOS default-suite step selects -m "platform_compat and not external"; that marker is
applied ONLY by tests/conftest.py::pytest_collection_modifyitems at collection time. The
Verified gate runs _build-and-test.yml from trusted main (reusable-workflow ref binding)
against the raw patchset tree, so a patchset predating the auto-marker collects 0 tests →
pytest rc 5 → job fails.

PROOF (discriminating runtime oracle)
current tree → 909 collected, rc 0; conftest auto-marker neutralized (= pre-marker tree)
→ 0 collected, rc 5. Isolates the auto-marker as the necessary cause; rules out
strict-markers (errors "unknown mark"), the invocation, and the integration tier.

DEFECT ORIGIN
caused_by 3ba8-49d5-fee5-445d (omphacite-desertlike-coney, commit 920492b1), class
regression. A split the contract across two halves — the workflow selection and the
conftest marker — and the trusted-main workflow half applies to patchset trees that lack
the conftest half. It escaped its own gate because A's gate run executed the pre-A full
macOS suite (the reduction only takes effect after merge, same ref-binding). Verified via
the rebar-ticket trailer on 920492b1.

TEST (RED→GREEN, held out from fixer)
test_macos_default_suite_lane_passes_when_platform_compat_collects_nothing renders the
step's GitHub expressions per cell, stubs pytest to exit 5, executes the real lane shell,
asserts macOS→0 / every ubuntu→5. Seen RED first on the unfixed workflow; GREEN after.

FIX
_build-and-test.yml default-suite step captures pytest rc and, ONLY on macos-latest, maps
rc 5 → success with a ::notice:: diagnostic. Restores pre-regression behaviour while
keeping A's speedup for current trees.

SCOPE & SAFETY
Restoration, not creation (re-establishes pre-A tolerance). No new dependency, no test
weakened. Every patchset is still fully exercised on the Ubuntu cells (marker-independent
whole-suite selection); a current-tree marker regression is still caught on Ubuntu by
test_platform_compat_suite_covers_the_core_os_sensitive_seams; rc 5 stays a real failure
on every non-macOS cell. Caller sweep: the only consumer is the gate lane itself — local,
no behavioural dependents.

SIBLINGS
Same defect CLASS as 1909-c1a7-9f20-440f (definition-vs-tree skew) but a distinct
mechanism (1909 guarded repo-SCRIPT-absence steps). NOT a duplicate; recorded as a
same-class sibling comment, not a duplicates link (which would corrupt escape metrics).
Parity census: the operation (Verified-lane marker selection) exists on exactly one
surface (the reusable workflow); no MISSING slots.

SECOND-ORDER FINDING (patchset 1 CI failure, self-inflicted, fixed in-scope)
Patchset 1 tripped test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py::test_completeness_every_gate_step_
is_guarded_or_marked on the ubuntu cells: that guard (from 1909) scans each Verified-lane
step's run body INCLUDING comments with a (scripts|tests|docs)/….py regex, and my shell
comment spelled the literal path "tests/conftest.py" → read as executing conftest.py
unguarded. FALSE POSITIVE: the guard models file ABSENCE on stale bases, but
tests/conftest.py has always existed; only its marker CONTENT is new (unmodelable by a
path regex). Fixed patchset 2 by rewording the comment to "the conftest auto-marker"
(dropping the tests/ prefix), preferred over a # predates-gate-ok marker which would
exempt the whole step. Proven RED→GREEN at the guard level.

RESIDUAL RISK & PREVENTION
The predates-gate guard's path-regex over comment text is inherently prone to
false-positives on any literal repo path mentioned in a comment. Accepted (one-line
reason): the guard's escape hatch (# predates-gate-ok:) and the safe-phrasing convention
already exist; a structural fix (scan only executable lines, not comments) is broader than
this bug's scope and belongs to the guard's owner. Not filed — low incidence, documented
convention exists.

REPLICATION
The original report no longer reproduces: patchset 2 passed all four pytest cells (Verified
+1), merged as e19863b6; new gate runs use the fixed trusted-main workflow. The behavioural
guard executing the real merged lane shell passed on the ubuntu cells in CI.
